newsitem.title: USA: Eastman Chemical to build chemicals plant.
newsitem.headline: Eastman Chemical to build chemicals plant.

text.p: Eastman Chemical Co said on Tuesday that it plans to build a fine chemicals plant to serve the pharmaceutical industry with intermediates and bulk actives.
Eastman's current manufacturing facility in Batesville, Ark., is among the sites being considered for the new plant, the company said in a news release.
Eastman said it plans to begin construction in 1998.
The company makes chemicals, fibers and plastics.
